package.name: storage_system
package.description: ROS1 node tracking SPL inventory across per-workspace (left/right) storage instances (Eurocontainer, Redboard, Gripper slots). Pure inventory/data service: tracks which SPL (id + state) occupies which slot index. Does not publish TF and does not interact with MoveIt's planning scene — those concerns are owned by the Supervisor BT / Robot Controllers / moveit_commander, which orchestrate calls to both. See storage_system/SPECS/20260731_StorageSystem_Spec_and_Roadmap.md for the full design rationale.
